pages.text: $(lilomon)$(#503a30)He held the Ring, alone and by himself. Its power answered with a force no flipper could bear. Horns grew for every moment he tried. the sky darkened, and the pain hurt him so bad.

$(lilomon)$(#503a30)His wings were torn, i remember rushing to hold the ring with him, to stop him from hurting. I remember reaching for him, only for him to turn away. I would have traded every star to help him again.
